units.title: Unit 1 — Consonant Doubling, Y Rules & Soft C/G

lessons.title: Doubling Consonants (1-1-1 Rule)
grammar: Doubling rule: 1 syllable + 1 vowel + 1 consonant before vowel suffix
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A2-001"
cando: "Can apply 1-1-1 doubling rule and recognize short vs long vowel signals."
task: "Contrast dinner vs diner."
speaking_focus: "Short vowel retention before double consonants."

lessons.title: Changing Y to I & Dropping Silent E Rules
grammar: Spelling and pronunciation changes with suffixes
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A2-002"
cando: "Can apply y-to-i and silent-e dropping rules accurately."
task: "Combine roots and suffixes while explaining spelling shifts."
speaking_focus: "Smooth suffix transition without vowel distortion."

lessons.title: Soft C and Soft G Expanded
grammar: Softening of C and G before E, I, Y and Germanic exceptions
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A2-003"
cando: "Can predict soft C and soft G sounds and recognize Germanic hard G exceptions."
task: "Sort C and G words into soft vs hard sound categories."
speaking_focus: "Fricative /s/ and affricate articulation."

units.title: Unit 2 — Bossy R & Common Suffix Pronunciations

lessons.title: R-Controlled Vowels (AR, OR, ER, IR, UR)
grammar: Vowel modification by following R in stressed and unstressed syllables
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A2-004"
cando: "Can produce R-controlled vowels in rhotic and non-rhotic contexts."
task: "Group er, ir, ur words under the same sound."
speaking_focus: "Tongue retraction for R-controlled vowels."

lessons.title: Core Suffix Pronunciations (-tion, -sion, -ly, -ness, -ment)
grammar: Pronunciation of common derivative suffixes and reduced vowels
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A2-005"
cando: "Can pronounce common suffixes with reduced schwa vowels."
task: "Read derivative words with unstressed suffix pronunciation."
speaking_focus: "De-emphasizing suffix syllables."

lessons.title: The "I Before E" Rule & Exception Patterns
grammar: I before E except after C rule and its main exception classes
lessons.teacher_notes:
code: "EN-PRON-A2-006"
cando: "Can apply I-before-E rule for long e and recognize common exception words."
task: "Dictation exercise targeting ie/ei spelling and pronunciation."
speaking_focus: "Long e vs diphthong /eI/ distinction."
